title: Turnaround statistics
bodyMd: A repair service reports that its median completion time fell from five days to three. A client concludes that every repair is now completed more quickly. The service explains that the median describes the middle of the distribution, not every case. A few complex repairs still take much longer, and the report gives no case-by-case comparison between periods.
